The '''houjix''' was a fierce-looking creature that lived on [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]], homeworld of the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]]. They were mild creatures and were often used as loyal, but cowardly pets.

Houjix were represented as [[Holomonster/Legends|holomonster]] playing pieces in the game of [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]].
